about.title: A passion for greenery and water since 2005
about.p1: Pool & Garden is an Italian company specialised in the construction and maintenance of pools, irrigation systems and artificial lawns. For over five years we have been turning ordinary outdoor spaces into welcoming, functional and beautiful places to live.
about.p2: Our team combines technical expertise, craftsmanship and the use of premium certified materials. We follow every project from the first idea to a turnkey delivery, and stay by your side with long-term maintenance.
about.missionText: To create outdoor spaces that improve people's quality of life, combining design, sustainability and reliability with transparent, tailored service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: This privacy policy describes how Pool & Garden collects, uses, and protects the personal data of website users, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (EU) 2016/679.

The Data Controller is Pool & Garden S.r.l., based in Via Trieste 98, 87046 Montalto Uffugo (CS), Italy. The purposes of data processing include: responding to requests submitted via the website forms (contact, quote, newsletter) and providing the requested services.

Processing is carried out with the user's consent and/or for the execution of a contract. Data collected via contact forms will be retained for 24 months, while newsletter-related data will be retained until the user requests cancellation.

Personal data may be processed by external providers appointed as Data Processors, including Netlify (website hosting), Aruba (domain management), and MailerLite (email sending platform), to ensure the correct functioning of the requested services.
Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability at any time by writing to: privacy@poolegarden.it.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
body: The website uses technical cookies necessary for its correct functioning (session, language preferences, consent banner). These cookies do not require prior consent as they are strictly necessary.
With prior consent, the website may use analytical cookies to collect aggregate usage statistics and third-party cookies necessary for the integration of interactive maps and social buttons.
Data collected through cookies may be managed by third-party platforms (such as MailerLite for tracking email opens) acting as Data Processors.
You can manage, accept, or revoke your consent at any time by using the 'Cookie Settings' button available in the website's footer.
This policy is drafted in compliance with current regulations and will be updated if new tracking technologies or services are introduced.

The information on the website is for illustrative purposes only and does not constitute a binding offer. Quotes provided via the forms will only have contractual value after written confirmation and acceptance through official documentation.
